mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE rise does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with subsequent market downturn.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the joint movement of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to historical averages indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances despite positive signal, or HOUST level does not correlate with subsequent market performance.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising), if Industrial Production (INDPRO) also increases, it signals resilient supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint movement of FEDFUNDS and INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent market resilience.
